Package com.csse3200.game.components.cards

Class CardInspectionController

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.input.InputComponent
com.csse3200.game.components.cards.CardInspectionController
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.badlogic.gdx.input.GestureDetector.GestureListener, com.badlogic.gdx.InputProcessor
public final class CardInspectionController extends InputComponent
Explicit F-key card inspection through the existing InputService and Stage.

Sources retain their own play/drag input and assets. Inspection is modal and pinned until F or the close control is used. Escape keeps the screen's existing pause/popup behaviour.
